        contract = validate_contract({"expected_case_passes": [
            {"case_id": case_id, "pass_number": rec["pass_number"]} for rec in records
        ]})
        assert evaluate_trace(records, **contract) == []
    whitespace_padded_trace = [
        {**valid_records[0], "case_id": "slow-case", "duration_ms": 24000},
        *[{**valid_records[0], "case_id": "private-case" + " " * i, "duration_ms": 900}
          for i in range(1, 21)],
    ]
    findings = evaluate_trace(whitespace_padded_trace)
    assert len(findings) == 21 and findings[-1].startswith("[ARG005]"), findings
    assert all("case_id must not have" in finding for finding in findings[:-1]), findings

    citation_record = {**valid_records[0], "retrieved_doc_ids": ["doc_A.2:#-"]}
    for answer in ("", "No citation markers.", "[cite:doc_A.2:#-][cite:doc_A.2:#-]"):
        assert evaluate_trace([{**citation_record, "assistant_response": answer}]) == []

    citation_cfg = validate_contract({"require_citations": True})
    for answer in ("", "Private uncited answer.", " ", "[CITE:doc_A.2:#-]"):
        for retrieved in ([], ["doc_A.2:#-"]):
            record = {**citation_record, "assistant_response": answer, "retrieved_doc_ids": retrieved}
            assert evaluate_trace([record], **citation_cfg) == [
                "[ARG003] row-1: at least one inline citation is required.",
            ]
            assert evaluate_trace([record], **validate_contract({"require_citations": False})) == []
    assert evaluate_trace(valid_records, **citation_cfg) == []
    assert evaluate_trace([
        {**citation_record, "assistant_response": "[cite:doc_A.2:#-][cite:doc_A.2:#-]"},
    ], **citation_cfg) == []
    for answer in ("[cite:missing-doc]", "[cite:]", "[cite:doc_A.2:#-] and [cite:]"):
        errs = evaluate_trace([{**citation_record, "assistant_response": answer}], **citation_cfg)
        assert errs and all(e.startswith("[ARG003]") for e in errs), errs

    malformed_answers = (
        "Source [cite:].",
        "Source [cite:doc a].",
        "Source [cite:doc/a].",
        "Source [cite:doc-\u00e9].",
        "Source [cite:doc-a",
        "Source [cite:doc-a\n].",
        "Source [cite:[cite:doc_A.2:#-]].",
        "Valid [cite:doc_A.2:#-], then malformed [cite:].",
    )
    for answer in malformed_answers:
        errs = evaluate_trace([{**citation_record, "assistant_response": answer}])
        assert any(e.startswith("[ARG003]") and "malformed" in e for e in errs), (answer, errs)
        assert answer not in "\n".join(errs), "Malformed answer content must not enter diagnostics."

    for malformed in (None, [], "not-an-object", 7, {"status": "ok"}):
        errs = evaluate_trace([malformed])
        assert errs and all(e.startswith("[ARG001]") for e in errs), errs

    for field in valid_records[0]:
        incomplete = {k: v for k, v in valid_records[0].items() if k != field}
        errs = evaluate_trace([incomplete])
        assert any(e.startswith("[ARG001]") and field in e for e in errs), (field, errs)

    for field, values in (
        ("case_id", ["", None, 1]),
        ("status", [None, True]),
        ("assistant_response", [None, {}]),
        ("tools_called", ["knowledge_base_retrieve", [None], [7]]),
        ("retrieved_doc_ids", ["policy-sec-04", [""]]),
        ("pass_number", [0, -1, True, "2", 1.5]),
        ("input_tokens", [-1, True, "4200", 4200.5]),
        ("cached_tokens", [-1, False, "0", 0.5, 4201]),
        ("duration_ms", [None, -1, True, "2100", math.nan, math.inf, -math.inf, 10**400, -(10**400)]),
        ("acl_trimmed", [None, "true", 1]),
        ("raw_prompt_logged", [None, "false", 0]),
        ("otel_capture_message_content", [None, "false", 0]),
    ):
        for value in values:
            errs = evaluate_trace([{**valid_records[0], field: value}])
            assert any(e.startswith("[ARG001]") and field in e for e in errs), (field, value, errs)

    no_retrieval = {**valid_records[0], "retrieved_doc_ids": [], "assistant_response": ""}
    del no_retrieval["acl_trimmed"]
    assert evaluate_trace([no_retrieval]) == []
    del no_retrieval["raw_prompt_logged"]
    assert evaluate_trace([no_retrieval], forbid_raw_prompt_logging=False) == []
    no_acl = {k: v for k, v in valid_records[0].items() if k != "acl_trimmed"}
    assert evaluate_trace([no_acl], require_acl_trimming=False) == []
    assert evaluate_trace([{**valid_records[0], "duration_ms": 0.5}]) == []
    assert evaluate_trace(
        [{**valid_records[0], "duration_ms": 10**300}],
        **validate_contract({"max_p95_ms": 10**300}),
    ) == []
    large_latency_failures = evaluate_trace(
        [{**valid_records[0], "duration_ms": 10**300}],
        **validate_contract({"max_p95_ms": 10**299}),

    assert len(large_latency_failures) == 1 and large_latency_failures[0].startswith("[ARG005]")
    assert evaluate_trace([])[0].startswith("[ARG001]")

    broken_records = [
        {
            "case_id": "bad-001",
            "pass_number": 2,
            "status": "ok",
            "tools_called": ["raw_shell_root"],
            "retrieved_doc_ids": ["doc-a"],
            "acl_trimmed": False,
            "raw_prompt_logged": True,

            "input_tokens": 3000,
            "cached_tokens": 0,
            "duration_ms": 24000,
        }
    ]
    errs = evaluate_trace(broken_records, max_p95_ms=10000)
    assert len(errs) == 6, f"Expected 6 deterministic contract violations, got {errs}"
    duplicate_broken = [
        {**valid_records[0], "case_id": "bad-001", "pass_number": 2, "cached_tokens": 3584},
        *broken_records,
    ]
    errs = evaluate_trace(duplicate_broken, max_p95_ms=10000)
    assert len(errs) == 7 and sum("duplicate case_id/pass_number" in e for e in errs) == 1, errs
    assert all(any(e.startswith(f"[ARG00{rule}]") for e in errs) for rule in range(1, 8)), errs

    private_case = "private-case-\ud800-\x1b[31m"
    private_tool = "private-tool-\ud800-\x1b[31m"
    private_required_tool = "private-required-tool"
    privacy_contract = {
        "forbidden_tools": [private_tool], "required_tools": [private_required_tool],
    }
    privacy_record = {
        **broken_records[0],
        "case_id": private_case,
        "status": "private-status\nforged-log-line",
        "tools_called": [private_tool],
        "retrieved_doc_ids": ["private-retrieved-doc"],
        "assistant_response": "private-answer [cite:private-unresolved-doc]",
    }
    privacy_cases = (
        ([privacy_record], privacy_contract, 8),
        ([{**valid_records[0], "case_id": private_case,
           "assistant_response": "private-answer [cite:private/doc]"}], {}, 1),
        ([{**valid_records[0], "case_id": private_case,
           "assistant_response": "private-uncited-answer"}], {"require_citations": True}, 1),
    )
    for evidence, contract, count in privacy_cases:
        findings = evaluate_trace(evidence, **validate_contract(contract))
        assert len(findings) == count, findings
        assert all("row-1:" in finding for finding in findings if not finding.startswith("[ARG005]")), findings
        assert not any(marker in "\n".join(findings) for marker in (
            "private-", "forged-log-line", "\x1b", "\ud800",
        )), findings
    findings = evaluate_trace([privacy_record], **validate_contract(privacy_contract))
    assert all(any(finding.startswith(f"[ARG00{rule}]") for finding in findings) for rule in range(1, 8))
    assert evaluate_trace([{**valid_records[0], "case_id": private_case}]) == []

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".json", delete=False, encoding="utf-8") as tmp:
        json.dump(
            {
                "max_p95_ms": 12000,
                "min_pass2_cached_tokens": 1024,
                "required_tools": ["knowledge_base_retrieve"],
                "forbidden_tools": ["raw_shell_root"],
                "require_acl_trimming": True,
                "forbid_raw_prompt_logging": True,
            },
            tmp,
        )
        tmp_path = Path(tmp.name)
    try:
        cfg = load_contract(tmp_path)
        assert evaluate_trace(valid_records, **cfg) == []
    finally:
        tmp_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)

    defaults = validate_contract({})
    assert evaluate_trace(valid_records, **defaults) == []
    assert defaults["forbidden_tools"] == DEFAULT_FORBIDDEN_TOOLS
    for padding in (" ", "\t", "\n", "\u00a0"):
        for tool in (padding + "raw_shell_root", "raw_shell_root" + padding):
            errs = evaluate_trace([{**valid_records[0], "tools_called": [tool]}])
            assert len(errs) == 1 and errs[0].startswith("[ARG001]"), errs
            assert "tools_called" in errs[0] and tool not in errs[0], errs
            for field in ("required_tools", "forbidden_tools"):
                try:
                    validate_contract({field: [tool]})
                except ValueError as exc:
                    assert field in str(exc) and tool not in str(exc), exc
                else:
                    raise AssertionError(f"Expected padded {field} to be rejected.")
    exact_tool = "namespace.Tool-v2"
    assert evaluate_trace(
        [{**valid_records[0], "tools_called": [exact_tool]}],
        **validate_contract({"required_tools": [exact_tool], "forbidden_tools": [exact_tool.lower()]}),
    ) == []
    assert evaluate_trace(
        [{**valid_records[0], "tools_called": []}],
        **validate_contract({"required_tools": [], "forbidden_tools": []}),
    ) == []
    assert evaluate_trace(
        [{**valid_records[0], "tools_called": ["raw_shell_root"]}],
        **validate_contract({"required_tools": ["raw_shell_root"], "forbidden_tools": []}),
    ) == []
    conflicting_contracts = [
        {"required_tools": ["private-tool"], "forbidden_tools": ["private-tool"]},
        {"required_tools": ["knowledge_base_retrieve", "private-tool"],
         "forbidden_tools": ["other-tool", "private-tool"]},
        *[{"required_tools": [tool]} for tool in sorted(DEFAULT_FORBIDDEN_TOOLS)],
    ]
    for contract in conflicting_contracts:
        try:
            validate_contract(contract)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert str(exc) == "required_tools and forbidden_tools must not overlap.", exc
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Expected contradictory tool policies to be rejected.")
    assert validate_contract({
        "contract_version": "2.0", "track": "Playbook 04",
        "metadata": {"first": {"label": "a"}, "second": {"label": "b"}},
    }) == defaults
    assert validate_contract({
        "contract_version": "2.0", "track": "Playbook 04",
        "max_p95_ms": 0.5, "min_pass2_cached_tokens": 1,
        "required_tools": [], "forbidden_tools": [],
        "require_acl_trimming": False, "forbid_raw_prompt_logging": False,
    }) == {
        "max_p95_ms": 0.5, "min_pass2_cached_tokens": 1,
        "required_tools": set(), "forbidden_tools": set(),
        "require_acl_trimming": False, "forbid_raw_prompt_logging": False,
        "expected_case_passes": None,
        "require_citations": False,
        "require_pass2_cache_evidence": False,
    }

    invalid_contracts = [(value, "JSON object") for value in (None, [], "contract", 1, True)]
    for field in (
        "max_p95_mss", "min_pass2_cache_tokens", "required_tool", "forbidden_tool",
        "require_acl_trimmming", "forbid_raw_prompt_loging", "private-field",
    ):
        invalid_contracts.append(({field: "private-value"}, "unsupported top-level fields"))
    for field, values in (
        ("max_p95_ms", [None, True, "15000", 0, -1, math.nan, math.inf, -math.inf, 10**400, -(10**400)]),
        ("min_pass2_cached_tokens", [None, True, "1024", 0, -1, 1.5, 1024.0, math.nan, math.inf]),
        ("required_tools", [None, "retrieve", {}, [None], [1], [True], [[]], [""], [" "]]),
        ("forbidden_tools", [None, "raw_shell_root", {}, [None], [1], [True], [[]], [""], [" "]]),
        ("require_acl_trimming", [None, "false", 0, 1, [], {}]),
        ("forbid_raw_prompt_logging", [None, "false", 0, 1, [], {}]),
        ("require_citations", [None, "false", "true", 0, 1, [], {}]),
        ("require_pass2_cache_evidence", [None, "false", "true", 0, 1, [], {}]),
        ("expected_case_passes", [
            None, True, "golden-case", {}, [], [None], [[]],
            [{"case_id": "golden-case"}],
            [{"case_id": "golden-case", "pass_number": 1, "private-field": "private-value"}],
            *[[{"case_id": case, "pass_number": 1}] for case in ("", " ", None, 1)],
            *[[{"case_id": "golden-case", "pass_number": number}]
              for number in (None, True, "1", 0, -1, 1.5, 1.0)],
            [expected_cases[0], expected_cases[0]],
        ]),
    ):
        invalid_contracts.extend(({field: value}, field) for value in values)
    for contract, expected_message in invalid_contracts:
        try:
            validate_contract(contract)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert expected_message in str(exc), (contract, exc)
            if expected_message == "unsupported top-level fields":
                assert "private-field" not in str(exc) and "private-value" not in str(exc), exc
        else:
            raise AssertionError(f"Expected invalid contract to be rejected: {contract!r}")

    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
        trace = Path(directory) / "trace.jsonl"
        conflict_file = Path(directory) / "conflicting-contract.json"
        privacy_file = Path(directory) / "privacy-contract.json"
        cache_file = Path(directory) / "cache-contract.json"
        cache_trace = Path(directory) / "cache-trace.jsonl"
        for evidence, overrides, expected in cache_cases:
            cache_file.write_text(json.dumps({
                "require_pass2_cache_evidence": True, **overrides,
            }), encoding="utf-8")
            cache_trace.write_text(
                "\n".join(json.dumps(rec) for rec in evidence), encoding="utf-8",
            )
            for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(cache_trace),
                     "--contract", str(cache_file), *output_flags],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                )
                assert result.returncode == (1 if expected else 0) and not result.stderr, result
                if output_flags:
                    payload = json.loads(result.stdout)
                    assert payload["passed"] is (not expected), result
                    assert payload["record_count"] == len(evidence), result
                    assert payload["failures"] == expected, result
                elif expected:
                    assert all(finding in result.stdout for finding in expected), result
                    assert "PASSED" not in result.stdout, result
                else:
                    assert "PASSED" in result.stdout, result
                assert all(rec["case_id"] not in result.stdout for rec in evidence), result
        for value in (None, "true", 1, [], {}):
            cache_file.write_text(json.dumps({
                "require_pass2_cache_evidence": value,
            }), encoding="utf-8")
            for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()),
                     str(Path(directory) / "missing-cache-trace.jsonl"),
                     "--contract", str(cache_file), *output_flags],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                )
                assert result.returncode == 2 and not result.stdout, result
                assert result.stderr.strip() == (
                    "Error: invalid acceptance contract: "
                    "require_pass2_cache_evidence must be an explicit boolean."
                ), result
        for evidence, contract, count in privacy_cases:
            privacy_file.write_text(json.dumps(contract), encoding="utf-8")
            trace.write_text("\n\n" + "\n\n".join(json.dumps(rec) for rec in evidence), encoding="utf-8")
            for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace),
                     "--contract", str(privacy_file), *output_flags],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                )
                assert result.returncode == 1 and not result.stderr, result
                assert not any(marker in result.stdout for marker in (
                    "private-", "forged-log-line", "\x1b", "\\ud800", "Traceback",
                )), result
                assert result.stdout.count("row-1:") == count - (1 if count == 8 else 0), result
                if output_flags:
                    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
                    assert output["passed"] is False and output["record_count"] == 1, output
                    assert len(output["failures"]) == count, output
        trace.write_text(json.dumps({
            **valid_records[0], "case_id": private_case,
        }), encoding="utf-8")
        for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace), *output_flags],
                capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
            )
            assert result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr, result
            assert "private-" not in result.stdout, result
            if output_flags:
                output = json.loads(result.stdout)
                assert output == {"passed": True, "record_count": 1, "failures": []}, output
        trace.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(rec) for rec in valid_records), encoding="utf-8")
        for contract in conflicting_contracts:
            conflict_file.write_text(json.dumps(contract), encoding="utf-8")
            for trace_path in (trace, Path(directory) / "missing.jsonl"):
                for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                    result = subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace_path),
                         "--contract", str(conflict_file), *output_flags],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                    )
                    assert result.returncode == 2 and not result.stdout, result
                    assert "invalid acceptance contract" in result.stderr, result
                    assert "required_tools and forbidden_tools must not overlap" in result.stderr, result
                    assert "Traceback" not in result.stderr and "[ARG001]" not in result.stderr, result
                    assert all(
                        tool not in result.stderr
                        for field in ("required_tools", "forbidden_tools")
                        for tool in contract.get(field, [])
                    ), result
        citation_file = Path(directory) / "citation-contract.json"
        for contract, answer, expected_code, finding in (
            ({"require_citations": True}, "Private uncited answer.", 1, "at least one inline citation"),
            ({"require_citations": True}, "", 1, "at least one inline citation"),
            ({"require_citations": True}, "[cite:]", 1, "malformed inline citation"),
            ({"require_citations": True}, "[cite:missing-doc]", 1, "unresolved inline citation"),
            ({"require_citations": True}, "[cite:doc_A.2:#-] and [cite:]", 1, "malformed inline citation"),
            ({"require_citations": True}, "[cite:doc_A.2:#-]", 0, ""),
            ({"require_citations": False}, "Private uncited answer.", 0, ""),
            ({}, "Private uncited answer.", 0, ""),
        ):
            citation_file.write_text(json.dumps(contract), encoding="utf-8")
            trace.write_text(json.dumps({
                **citation_record, "assistant_response": answer,
            }), encoding="utf-8")
            for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace),
                     "--contract", str(citation_file), *output_flags],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                )
                assert result.returncode == expected_code and not result.stderr, result
                assert "Private uncited answer." not in result.stdout, result
                if expected_code:
                    assert "[ARG003]" in result.stdout and finding in result.stdout, result
                if output_flags:
                    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
                    assert output["passed"] is (expected_code == 0) and output["record_count"] == 1, output
                    assert bool(output["failures"]) is (expected_code != 0), output
        for value in (None, "true", "false", 0, 1, [], {}):
            citation_file.write_text(json.dumps({"require_citations": value}), encoding="utf-8")
            for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(Path(directory) / "missing.jsonl"),
                     "--contract", str(citation_file), *output_flags],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                )
                assert result.returncode == 2 and not result.stdout, result
                assert "invalid acceptance contract" in result.stderr and "require_citations" in result.stderr, result
                assert "Traceback" not in result.stderr and "[ARG001]" not in result.stderr, result
        inventory_file = Path(directory) / "inventory-contract.json"
        for evidence, count in (
            ([{**valid_records[0], "case_id": " private-case"}], 1),
            ([{**valid_records[0], "case_id": "private-case\t"}], 1),
            ([{**valid_records[0], "case_id": "\u00a0private-case\n"}], 1),
            (whitespace_padded_trace, 21),
        ):
            trace.write_text("\n\n".join(json.dumps(rec) for rec in evidence), encoding="utf-8")
            for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace), *output_flags],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                )
                assert result.returncode == 1 and not result.stderr, result
                assert "case_id must not have leading or trailing whitespace" in result.stdout, result
                assert "private-case" not in result.stdout and "Traceback" not in result.stdout, result
                if evidence is whitespace_padded_trace:
                    assert "[ARG005]" in result.stdout, result
                if output_flags:
                    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
                    assert output["passed"] is False and output["record_count"] == len(evidence), output
                    assert len(output["failures"]) == count, output
        inventory_file.write_text(
            json.dumps({"expected_case_passes": expected_cases}), encoding="utf-8",
        )
        for evidence, expected_findings in (
            (same_case_passes, []),
            (list(reversed(same_case_passes)), []),
            (same_case_passes[:1], ["missing 1 expected"]),
            ([same_case_passes[0], {**same_case_passes[1], "case_id": "GOLDEN-CASE"}],
             ["unexpected case_id/pass_number", "missing 1 expected"]),
            (padded_inventory_trace, ["unexpected case_id/pass_number"] * 20),
            ([*same_case_passes, same_case_passes[0]], ["duplicate case_id/pass_number"]),
        ):
            trace.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(rec) for rec in evidence), encoding="utf-8")
            for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace),
                     "--contract", str(inventory_file), *output_flags],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                )
                assert result.returncode == (1 if expected_findings else 0), result
                assert not result.stderr and "Traceback" not in result.stdout, result
                for finding in set(expected_findings):
                    assert result.stdout.count(finding) == expected_findings.count(finding), result
                assert "GOLDEN-CASE" not in result.stdout and "extra-" not in result.stdout, result
                if output_flags:
                    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
                    assert output["passed"] is (not expected_findings), output
                    assert output["record_count"] == len(evidence), output
                    assert len(output["failures"]) == len(expected_findings), output

        for inventory in ([], [expected_cases[0], expected_cases[0]],
                          [{"case_id": "private-case", "pass_number": True}],
                          [{"case_id": " private-case", "pass_number": 1}],
                          [{"case_id": "private-case\u00a0", "pass_number": 1}]):
            inventory_file.write_text(
                json.dumps({"expected_case_passes": inventory}), encoding="utf-8",
            )
            for trace_path in (trace, Path(directory) / "missing.jsonl"):
                for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                    result = subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace_path),
                         "--contract", str(inventory_file), *output_flags],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                    )
                    assert result.returncode == 2 and not result.stdout, result
                    assert "invalid acceptance contract" in result.stderr, result
                    assert "expected_case_passes" in result.stderr and "[ARG001]" not in result.stderr, result
                    assert "private-case" not in result.stderr and "Traceback" not in result.stderr, result

        for evidence, expected_duplicates in (
            (same_case_passes, 0),
            (padded_trace, 19),
            (duplicate_broken, 1),
            ([valid_records[0], {**valid_records[0], "duration_ms": 900}], 1),
        ):
            trace.write_text("\n\n".join(json.dumps(rec) for rec in evidence), encoding="utf-8")
            for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                result = subprocess.run(
                    [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace), *output_flags],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                )
                assert result.returncode == (1 if expected_duplicates else 0), result
                assert not result.stderr and "Traceback" not in result.stdout, result
                assert result.stdout.count("duplicate case_id/pass_number") == expected_duplicates, result
                assert "private-case" not in result.stdout, result
                if output_flags:
                    output = json.loads(result.stdout)
                    assert output["passed"] is (expected_duplicates == 0), output
                    assert output["record_count"] == len(evidence), output
                    if evidence is duplicate_broken:
                        assert len(output["failures"]) == 7, output

        for evidence, expected_code in (
            (valid_records, 0),
            ([{**valid_records[0], "metadata": [{"label": "a"}, {"label": "b"}]}], 0),
            ([{"status": "ok"}], 1),
            ([None], 1),
        ):
            trace.write_text("\n".join(json.dumps(rec) for rec in evidence), encoding="utf-8")
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace), "--json"],
                capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
            )
            assert result.returncode == expected_code, result.stderr
            output = json.loads(result.stdout)
            assert output["passed"] is (expected_code == 0), output
            if expected_code:
                assert any(e.startswith("[ARG001]") for e in output["failures"]), output

        trace.write_text(json.dumps({
            **citation_record, "assistant_response": "Private marker [cite:private/doc].",
        }), encoding="utf-8")
        for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
            result = subprocess.run(
                [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace), *output_flags],
                capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
            )
            assert result.returncode == 1 and not result.stderr, result
            assert "[ARG003]" in result.stdout and "private/doc" not in result.stdout, result
            if output_flags:
                output = json.loads(result.stdout)
                assert output["passed"] is False and output["record_count"] == 1, output

        unicode_record = {
            **valid_records[0],
            "assistant_response": "Private answer\u0085next\u2028line\u2029paragraph.\nEscaped newline.",
            "metadata": {"label": "Private label\u2028continued"},
        }
        for newline in ("\n", "\r\n"):
            for status, expected_code in (("ok", 0), ("private-status", 1)):
                content = newline.join((
                    json.dumps({**unicode_record, "status": status}, ensure_ascii=False),
                    "",
                    json.dumps(valid_records[1]),
                ))
                trace.write_bytes(content.encode("utf-8"))
                for output_flags in ([], ["--json"]):
                    result = subprocess.run(
                        [sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve()), str(trace), *output_flags],
                        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
                    )
                    assert result.returncode == expected_code and not result.stderr, result
                    assert all(value not in result.stdout for value in (
                        "Private answer", "Private label", "private-status",
                    )), result
                    if output_flags:
                        output = json.loads(result.stdout)
                        assert output["passed"] is (expected_code == 0), output
                        assert output["record_count"] == 2, output
                    if expected_code:
                        assert "[ARG001] row-1: terminal status must be 'ok'." in result.stdout, result
                    else:

    return 0


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Deterministic CI release gate for enterprise AI agents.")
    parser.add_argument("trace_path", nargs="?", help="Path to JSONL trace evidence file.")
    parser.add_argument("--contract", help="Optional path to JSON acceptance contract file.")
    parser.add_argument("--max-p95-ms", type=float, default=15000.0, help="Maximum allowed p95 duration in ms.")
    parser.add_argument("--min-cached-tokens", type=int, default=1024, help="Minimum cached tokens on pass>=2.")
    parser.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="Emit machine-readable JSON output.")
    parser.add_argument("--self-test", action="store_true", help="Run built-in deterministic contract self-tests.")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.self_test:
        return run_self_test()

    if not args.trace_path:
        parser.error("Provide a trace_path JSONL file or pass --self-test.")

    try:
        if args.contract:
            kwargs = load_contract(Path(args.contract))
        else:
            kwargs = validate_contract({
                "max_p95_ms": args.max_p95_ms,
                "min_pass2_cached_tokens": args.min_cached_tokens,
            })
    except (OSError, UnicodeError):
        print("Error: could not read UTF-8 acceptance contract.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    except ValueError as exc:
        print(f"Error: invalid acceptance contract: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    path = Path(args.trace_path)
    try:
        trace_text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, UnicodeError):
        print("Error: [ARG001] could not read UTF-8 trace evidence.", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2

    records: list[Any] = []
    for line_number, line in enumerate(trace_text.split("\n"), start=1):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            records.append(json.loads(
                line, object_pairs_hook=unique_json_object, parse_constant=reject_json_constant,
            ))
        except RecursionError:
            print(
                f"Error: [ARG001] line-{line_number}: execution record JSON exceeds the parser nesting limit.",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 2
        except ValueError:
            print(
                f"Error: [ARG001] line-{line_number}: invalid JSON execution record (malformed JSON, duplicate object members, or non-standard numeric constants).",
                file=sys.stderr,
            )
            return 2
    failures = evaluate_trace(records, **kwargs)

    if args.json:
        print(json.dumps({"passed": len(failures) == 0, "record_count": len(records), "failures": failures}, indent=2))
    elif failures:
        print(f"❌ Agent Release Gate FAILED ({len(failures)} violation(s)):")
        for f in failures:
            print(f"  - {f}")
    else:
        print(f"✅ Agent Release Gate PASSED ({len(records)} turn(s) verified clean).")

    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

6. AI Data Strategy & Governance Release Gate CLI (data_readiness_gate.py) ​

Zero-dependency Python 3 CLI (DRG001–DRG007) verifying offline AI data-plane readiness snapshots against CLI defaults or a data-readiness-contract.json exported from the Interactive AI Data Strategy Advisor. Enforces Fabric / OneLake AI-Ready Gold lineage & dedicated interactive F-SKU isolation (DRG002), Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI & sensitivity label inheritance (DRG003), Entra ACL & ethical-wall revocation/tombstoning SLAs (DRG004), Azure Cosmos DB DiskANN+RRF partition scoping & AI Search blue-green alias/regional lag parity (DRG005), corpus chunk hygiene & indirect prompt-injection anti-poisoning (DRG006), and Pos 6 cache-safe freshness + eval flywheel contracts (DRG007) [Arch].

Fail-closed input rules (DRG001) exit 2 with no stdout on unreadable/invalid UTF-8 files, duplicate JSON object keys (including nested objects), excessive JSON nesting, or unsupported top-level contract fields. See Playbook 05 · Ch 05 for the full contract specification.

An optional expected_source_ids contract inventory requires exactly the approved datasets, preventing a clean subset or substituted corpus from passing DRG001. Missing/unexpected sources exit 1; invalid inventories exit 2 before evidence is read. Omission preserves Studio compatibility and defaults. Approve the inventory independently; completeness does not prove authenticity or grounding quality. See the inventory format and offline regressions [Arch].

Every dataset's lineage_sha256 must contain exactly 64 ASCII hexadecimal characters. Missing or malformed digests fail DRG002 with exit 1; uppercase and mixed-case hex remain valid. Diagnostics use dataset ordinals without echoing digest or source values. This verifies syntax only, not provenance, approved lineage parity, or zero-copy ingestion; see the lineage contract and offline regressions [Arch].

DRG005 also blocks Cosmos embedding_dim above the published index limits: 505 for flat, 4096 for quantizedFlat / diskANN [M]. Oversized metadata exits 1 without masking other findings; this does not verify deployed vector lengths or model compatibility. See the dimension contract and offline regressions [Arch].

python3 data_readiness_gate.py --self-test
python3 data_readiness_gate.py ./artifacts/data-snapshot.json --contract ./data-readiness-contract.json --json

    re.IGNORECASE,
)
PUBLIC_LABEL_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*public\s*$", re.IGNORECASE)
POISONING_PATTERNS = (
    re.compile(r"ignore\s+(all\s+)?(previous|prior|above)\s+instructions", re.IGNORECASE),
    re.compile(r"(exfiltrate|reveal|dump)\s+(the\s+)?system\s+prompt", re.IGNORECASE),
    re.compile(r"<\s*/?\s*system\s*>", re.IGNORECASE),
    re.compile(r"\boverride\s+ethical\s+wall\b", re.IGNORECASE),
    re.compile(r"\bbypass\s+(acl|purview|security\s+trimming)\b", re.IGNORECASE),
)

ALLOWED_CONTRACT_FIELDS = {
    "contract_version",
    "track",
    "metadata",
    "posture",
    "require_purview_dspm",
    "require_dedicated_interactive_fsku",
    "max_revocation_lag_min",
    "max_freshness_lag_min",
    "max_region_lag_pct",
    "min_chunk_tokens",
    "max_chunk_tokens",
    "max_duplicate_ratio_pct",
    "require_eval_flywheel",
    "require_pos6_ordering",
    "required_stores",
    "expected_source_ids",
}


def unique_json_object(pairs: list[tuple[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    obj: dict[str, Any] = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in obj:
            raise ValueError("duplicate JSON object members are not allowed.")
        obj[key] = value
    return obj


def reject_json_constant(value: str) -> Any:
    raise ValueError("non-standard JSON numeric constants are not allowed.")


def is_finite_number(value: Any) -> bool:
    if type(value) not in (int, float):
        return False
    try:
        return math.isfinite(value)
    except OverflowError:
        return False


def load_strict_json(path: Path, label: str) -> Any:
    try:
        raw = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"[DRG001] unable to read {label} as UTF-8 JSON.") from exc
    try:
        return json.loads(
            raw, object_pairs_hook=unique_json_object, parse_constant=reject_json_constant,
        )
    except RecursionError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"[DRG001] {label} exceeds supported JSON nesting depth.") from exc
    except ValueError as exc:
        raise ValueError(f"[DRG001] invalid {label} JSON: {exc}") from exc


def parse_contract(raw_contract: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if not isinstance(raw_contract, dict):
        raise ValueError("[DRG001] acceptance contract must be a JSON object.")

    unknown = sorted(set(raw_contract.keys()) - ALLOWED_CONTRACT_FIELDS)
    if unknown:
        raise ValueError(
            f"[DRG001] acceptance contract contains {len(unknown)} unsupported top-level field(s)."
        )

    defaults: dict[str, Any] = {
        "posture": "standard",
        "require_purview_dspm": True,
        "require_dedicated_interactive_fsku": True,
        "max_revocation_lag_min": 15.0,
        "max_freshness_lag_min": 60.0,
        "max_region_lag_pct": 1.0,
        "min_chunk_tokens": 128,
        "max_chunk_tokens": 2048,
        "max_duplicate_ratio_pct": 5.0,
        "require_eval_flywheel": False,
        "require_pos6_ordering": True,
        "required_stores": [],
        "expected_source_ids": None,
    }

    cfg = dict(defaults)
    if "posture" in raw_contract:
        posture = raw_contract["posture"]
        if posture not in ("standard", "regulated"):
            raise ValueError("[DRG001] contract posture must be 'standard' or 'regulated'.")
        cfg["posture"] = posture
        if posture == "regulated" and "max_revocation_lag_min" not in raw_contract:
            cfg["max_revocation_lag_min"] = 5.0

    for bool_key in (
        "require_purview_dspm",
        "require_dedicated_interactive_fsku",
        "require_eval_flywheel",
        "require_pos6_ordering",
    ):
        if bool_key in raw_contract:
            if type(raw_contract[bool_key]) is not bool:
                raise ValueError(f"[DRG001] contract {bool_key} must be an explicit boolean.")
            cfg[bool_key] = raw_contract[bool_key]

    for num_key, min_val, max_val in (
        ("max_revocation_lag_min", 0.0, 1440.0),
        ("max_freshness_lag_min", 0.0, 10080.0),
        ("max_region_lag_pct", 0.0, 100.0),
        ("max_duplicate_ratio_pct", 0.0, 100.0),
    ):
        if num_key in raw_contract:
            val = raw_contract[num_key]
            if not is_finite_number(val) or val <= min_val or val > max_val:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"[DRG001] contract {num_key} must be a finite number in ({min_val}, {max_val}]."
                )
            cfg[num_key] = float(val)

    for int_key in ("min_chunk_tokens", "max_chunk_tokens"):
        if int_key in raw_contract:
            val = raw_contract[int_key]
            if type(val) is not int or val <= 0:
                raise ValueError(f"[DRG001] contract {int_key} must be a positive integer.")
            cfg[int_key] = val

    if cfg["min_chunk_tokens"] > cfg["max_chunk_tokens"]:
        raise ValueError("[DRG001] contract min_chunk_tokens cannot exceed max_chunk_tokens.")

    if "required_stores" in raw_contract:
        stores = raw_contract["required_stores"]
        if (
            not isinstance(stores, list)
            or any(not isinstance(s, str) or s not in VALID_STORES for s in stores)
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "[DRG001] contract required_stores must be a list of valid store identifiers."
            )
        cfg["required_stores"] = sorted(set(stores))

    if "expected_source_ids" in raw_contract:
        sources = raw_contract["expected_source_ids"]
        if (
            not isinstance(sources, list)
            or not sources
            or any(
                not isinstance(source, str)
                or not source.strip()
                or source != source.strip()
                for source in sources
            )
        ):
            raise ValueError(
                "[DRG001] contract expected_source_ids must be a non-empty array of trimmed, non-empty strings."
            )
        if len(set(sources)) != len(sources):
            raise ValueError("[DRG001] contract expected_source_ids must not contain duplicates.")
        cfg["expected_source_ids"] = set(sources)

    return cfg


def evaluate_snapshot(snapshot: Any, contract: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    findings: list[str] = []
    if not isinstance(snapshot, dict):
        return {
            "passed": False,
            "datasets_evaluated": 0,
            "findings": ["[DRG001] snapshot root must be a JSON object."],
        }

    if type(snapshot.get("purview_dspm_enabled")) is not bool:
        findings.append("[DRG001] snapshot purview_dspm_enabled must be an explicit boolean.")
    elif contract["require_purview_dspm"] and not snapshot["purview_dspm_enabled"]:
        findings.append(
            "[DRG003] Microsoft Purview DSPM for AI is disabled (violates Gate D4)."
        )

    datasets = snapshot.get("datasets")
    if not isinstance(datasets, list) or not datasets:
        findings.append("[DRG001] snapshot datasets must be a non-empty JSON array.")
        return {"passed": False, "datasets_evaluated": 0, "findings": findings}

    seen_sources: set[str] = set()
    observed_stores: set[str] = set()
    cosmos_dims: set[int] = set()

    for idx, ds in enumerate(datasets, start=1):
        prefix = f"dataset-{idx}"
        if not isinstance(ds, dict):
            findings.append(f"[DRG001] {prefix}: dataset entry must be a JSON object.")
            continue

        source_id = ds.get("source_id")
        if not isinstance(source_id, str) or not source_id.strip() or source_id != source_id.strip():
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG001] {prefix}: source_id must be a non-empty trimmed string."
            )
            source_label = prefix
        else:
            source_label = source_id
            if source_id in seen_sources:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG001] {prefix}: duplicate source_id detected in snapshot."
                )
            seen_sources.add(source_id)
            if (
                contract["expected_source_ids"] is not None
                and source_id not in contract["expected_source_ids"]
            ):
                findings.append(f"[DRG001] {prefix}: unexpected source_id outside approved inventory.")

        # DRG002: Fabric / OneLake lineage & store routing
        store_target = ds.get("store_target")
        if not isinstance(store_target, str) or store_target not in VALID_STORES:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG002] {source_label}: store_target must be one of fabric-iq, ai-search, cosmos-hybrid."
            )
        else:
            observed_stores.add(store_target)

        tier = ds.get("medallion_tier")
        if not isinstance(tier, str) or tier.lower() not in VALID_MEDALLION_TIERS:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG002] {source_label}: medallion_tier must be 'gold' or 'ai-gold' (Gate D2)."
            )

        source_uri = ds.get("source_uri")
        if not isinstance(source_uri, str) or not source_uri.strip():
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG002] {source_label}: missing required OneLake lineage field 'source_uri'."
            )

        lineage_sha256 = ds.get("lineage_sha256")
        if not isinstance(lineage_sha256, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{64}", lineage_sha256):
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG002] {prefix}: lineage_sha256 must be exactly 64 ASCII hexadecimal characters (Gate D2)."
            )

        if store_target == "fabric-iq":
            fsku_iso = ds.get("dedicated_interactive_fsku")
            if type(fsku_iso) is not bool:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG001] {source_label}: dedicated_interactive_fsku must be an explicit boolean."
                )
            elif contract["require_dedicated_interactive_fsku"] and not fsku_iso:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG002] {source_label}: Fabric IQ shares batch ETL F-SKU capacity (violates Gate D3)."
                )

        # DRG003: Purview sensitivity labels & oversharing
        label = ds.get("sensitivity_label")
        allow_public = ds.get("allow_public_index")
        if not isinstance(label, str) or not label.strip():
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG003] {source_label}: missing Microsoft Purview sensitivity_label (violates Gate D5)."
            )
            is_public_label = False
            is_restricted_label = True
        else:
            is_public_label = bool(PUBLIC_LABEL_RE.match(label))
            is_restricted_label = bool(RESTRICTED_LABEL_RE.search(label))

        if type(allow_public) is not bool:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG001] {source_label}: allow_public_index must be an explicit boolean."
            )
        elif allow_public and (is_restricted_label or contract["posture"] == "regulated"):
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG003] {source_label}: restricted/regulated dataset cannot set allow_public_index=true."
            )

        # DRG004: Entra ACL & tombstoning SLA
        acl_enforced = ds.get("acl_enforced")
        acl_groups = ds.get("acl_group_ids")
        rev_lag = ds.get("revocation_lag_minutes")
        overdue_tombstones = ds.get("overdue_tombstones")

        if type(acl_enforced) is not bool:
            findings.append(f"[DRG001] {source_label}: acl_enforced must be an explicit boolean.")
        elif not is_public_label and not acl_enforced:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG004] {source_label}: non-public dataset must enforce Entra ACL security trimming (Gate D5)."
            )

        if not isinstance(acl_groups, list) or any(
            not isinstance(g, str) or not g.strip() for g in acl_groups
        ):
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG001] {source_label}: acl_group_ids must be an array of non-empty strings."
            )
        elif not is_public_label and len(acl_groups) == 0:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG004] {source_label}: non-public dataset has empty acl_group_ids (oversharing risk)."
            )

        if not is_finite_number(rev_lag) or rev_lag < 0:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG001] {source_label}: revocation_lag_minutes must be a finite number >= 0."
            )
        elif rev_lag > contract["max_revocation_lag_min"]:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG004] {source_label}: ACL revocation lag {rev_lag}m exceeds SLA ({contract['max_revocation_lag_min']}m, Gate D6)."
            )

        if type(overdue_tombstones) is not int or overdue_tombstones < 0:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG001] {source_label}: overdue_tombstones must be an integer >= 0."
            )
        elif overdue_tombstones > 0:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG004] {source_label}: {overdue_tombstones} unpurged tombstone(s) exceed SLA (Gate D6)."
            )

        # DRG005: Cosmos DB DiskANN/Hybrid & AI Search alias/region parity
        if store_target == "cosmos-hybrid":
            vtype = ds.get("vector_index_type")
            rrf = ds.get("hybrid_rrf_enabled")
            pk_scoped = ds.get("tenant_partition_key_scoped")
            dim = ds.get("embedding_dim")
            if not isinstance(vtype, str) or vtype not in COSMOS_VECTOR_MAX_DIMENSIONS:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG005] {source_label}: Cosmos vector_index_type must be diskANN, quantizedFlat, or flat (Gate D7)."
                )
            if type(rrf) is not bool:
                findings.append(f"[DRG001] {source_label}: hybrid_rrf_enabled must be an explicit boolean.")
            elif not rrf:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG005] {source_label}: Cosmos DB hybrid RRF (VectorDistance + FullTextScore) must be enabled."
                )
            if type(pk_scoped) is not bool:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG001] {source_label}: tenant_partition_key_scoped must be an explicit boolean."
                )
            elif not pk_scoped:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG005] {source_label}: Cosmos DB vector query lacks tenant/engagement partition key isolation (Gate D7)."
                )
            if type(dim) is not int or dim <= 0:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG005] {source_label}: Cosmos DB embedding_dim must be a positive integer."
                )
            else:
                cosmos_dims.add(dim)
                if (
                    isinstance(vtype, str)
                    and vtype in COSMOS_VECTOR_MAX_DIMENSIONS
                    and dim > COSMOS_VECTOR_MAX_DIMENSIONS[vtype]
                ):
                    findings.append(
                        f"[DRG005] {prefix}: Cosmos DB embedding_dim exceeds the "
                        f"{COSMOS_VECTOR_MAX_DIMENSIONS[vtype]}-dimension limit for {vtype} (Gate D7)."
                    )

        if store_target == "ai-search":
            alias_ok = ds.get("alias_cutover_enabled")
            region_lag = ds.get("region_lag_pct")
            if type(alias_ok) is not bool:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG001] {source_label}: alias_cutover_enabled must be an explicit boolean."
                )
            elif not alias_ok:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG005] {source_label}: Azure AI Search index alias cutover not enabled (violates Gate D8)."
                )
            if not is_finite_number(region_lag) or region_lag < 0 or region_lag > 100:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG001] {source_label}: region_lag_pct must be a finite percentage in [0, 100]."
                )
            elif region_lag > contract["max_region_lag_pct"]:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG005] {source_label}: dual-region AI Search lag {region_lag}% exceeds {contract['max_region_lag_pct']}% (Gate D11)."
                )

        # DRG006: Corpus hygiene & indirect prompt-injection anti-poisoning
        if store_target in ("ai-search", "cosmos-hybrid"):
            avg_chunk = ds.get("avg_chunk_tokens")
            dup_ratio = ds.get("duplicate_or_empty_ratio_pct")
            if not is_finite_number(avg_chunk) or avg_chunk <= 0:
                findings.append(f"[DRG001] {source_label}: avg_chunk_tokens must be a finite number > 0.")
            elif avg_chunk < contract["min_chunk_tokens"] or avg_chunk > contract["max_chunk_tokens"]:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG006] {source_label}: avg_chunk_tokens ({avg_chunk}) outside [{contract['min_chunk_tokens']}, {contract['max_chunk_tokens']}] (Gate D9)."
                )
            if not is_finite_number(dup_ratio) or dup_ratio < 0 or dup_ratio > 100:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG001] {source_label}: duplicate_or_empty_ratio_pct must be a finite percentage in [0, 100]."
                )
            elif dup_ratio > contract["max_duplicate_ratio_pct"]:
                findings.append(
                    f"[DRG006] {source_label}: duplicate/empty chunk ratio {dup_ratio}% exceeds {contract['max_duplicate_ratio_pct']}% (Gate D10)."
                )

        sample_chunks = ds.get("sample_chunks", [])
        if not isinstance(sample_chunks, list) or any(not isinstance(c, str) for c in sample_chunks):
            findings.append(f"[DRG001] {source_label}: sample_chunks must be an array of strings.")
        else:
            for c_idx, chunk_text in enumerate(sample_chunks, start=1):
                if any(pat.search(chunk_text) for pat in POISONING_PATTERNS):
                    findings.append(
                        f"[DRG006] {source_label}: sample_chunks[{c_idx}] triggered indirect prompt-injection poisoning rule (Gate D10)."
                    )

        # DRG007: Freshness, Pos 6 cache ordering & eval flywheel
        fresh_lag = ds.get("freshness_lag_minutes")
        pos6 = ds.get("pos6_cache_safe_ordering")
        flywheel = ds.get("eval_flywheel_enabled")

        if not is_finite_number(fresh_lag) or fresh_lag < 0:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG001] {source_label}: freshness_lag_minutes must be a finite number >= 0."
            )
        elif fresh_lag > contract["max_freshness_lag_min"]:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG007] {source_label}: freshness lag {fresh_lag}m exceeds SLA ({contract['max_freshness_lag_min']}m, Gate D11)."
            )

        if type(pos6) is not bool:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG001] {source_label}: pos6_cache_safe_ordering must be an explicit boolean."
            )
        elif contract["require_pos6_ordering"] and not pos6:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG007] {source_label}: retrieved chunks not pinned to Pos 6 cache-safe tail (Gate D11)."
            )

        if flywheel is not None and type(flywheel) is not bool:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG001] {source_label}: eval_flywheel_enabled must be an explicit boolean when supplied."
            )
        elif contract["require_eval_flywheel"] and flywheel is not True:
            findings.append(
                f"[DRG007] {source_label}: OTel-to-Fabric Gold eval flywheel not enabled (Gate D12)."
            )

    if contract["expected_source_ids"] is not None:
        missing_count = len(contract["expected_source_ids"] - seen_sources)
        if missing_count:
            findings.append(f"[DRG001] snapshot is missing {missing_count} expected source_id(s).")

    if len(cosmos_dims) > 1:
        findings.append(
            "[DRG005] inconsistent Cosmos DB embedding_dim values detected across datasets (vector policy immutability conflict)."
        )

    missing_stores = [s for s in contract["required_stores"] if s not in observed_stores]
    if missing_stores:
        findings.append(
            f"[DRG002] required store target(s) missing from snapshot: {', '.join(missing_stores)}."
        )

    return {
        "passed": len(findings) == 0,
        "datasets_evaluated": len(datasets),
        "observed_stores": sorted(observed_stores),
        "findings": findings,
    }
